overview.description: The Virtus Biotech ETF (BBP) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the LifeSci Biotechnology Products index. The fund tracks an index of US-listed biotechnology companies considered to be in the product stage by the index provider. BBP was launched on Dec 17, 2014 and is issued by Virtus Investment Partners.
